newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-UNFIT SKIPPER LAUDRUP TO MISS CROATIA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNFIT SKIPPER LAUDRUP TO MISS CROATIA MATCH.

text.p: Captain Michael Laudrup has pulled out of Denmark's World Cup European group one qualifier against Croatia in Split on March 29.
Midfielder Laudrup, who plays for Japan's Vissel Kobe, cited lack of training for dropping out of Swedish-born national trainer Bo Johansson's 18-man squad, announced on Thursday.

His absence leaves younger brother Brian Laudrup of Glasgow Rangers to lead the attack against Croatia, who ousted Denmark from the European championships in England last year with a humiliating 3-0 defeat.
The only newcomer to the squad is untried midfielder Jon Dahl Tomasson of Dutch team Heerenveen.
Goalkeepers: Peter Schmeichel (Manchester United), Mogens Krogh (Brondby).
Defenders: Jacob Laursen (Derby), Marc Rieper (West Ham), Jes Hoegh (Fenerbahce), Jan Heintze (Bayer Leverkusen), Soeren Colding (Brondby).

Midfielders: Allan Nielsen (Tottenham), Michael Schjoenberg (Kaiserlautern), Per Frandsen (Bolton), Claus Thomsen (Everton), Jon Dahl Tomasson (Heerenveen), Brian Steen Nielsen (Odense), Thomas Helveg (Udinese).
Strikers: Brian Laudrup (Glasgow Rangers), Per Pedersen (Blackburn), Mikkel Beck (Middlesbrough), Peter Moeller (Brondby).
